# D2 results (EXPLORATORY): can the digitiser's output catch the silent failures?

*Generated by `scripts/analysis/section_D2.py`. Rules were fixed in `docs/plan/analysis_plan_changes.md` (2026-11-07) before any result. New 100 recordings only; images with a reading; target = wrong heart rate > 5 bpm; whole recordings held out (5-fold x10). No verdict word is used.*

- Images: 1265; wrong readings: 86; recordings: 99 (86 events are below the 100 recommended: small sample).
- **Improvement criterion (fixed in advance): within-damage AUC inside resolution level 5 and blur level 5 at least 0.70 with lower 95% bound above 0.50. Result: MET.**

## Overall AUC (cross-validated)

| model | auc | ci95 |
|---|---|---|
| PHOTO (five photo scores) | 0.828 | 0.77 to 0.89 |
| OUTPUT (digitised-signal features) | 0.914 | 0.88 to 0.95 |
| BOTH | 0.95 | 0.93 to 0.97 |
| ORACLE (told damage type and level) | 0.821 | 0.76 to 0.89 |

| resolution level 5 | 99 | 47 | BOTH | 0.859 | 0.78 to 0.92 |
| blur level 5 | 98 | 17 | PHOTO (five photo scores) | 0.371 | 0.21 to 0.54 |
| blur level 5 | 98 | 17 | OUTPUT (digitised-signal features) | 0.829 | 0.69 to 0.94 |
| blur level 5 | 98 | 17 | BOTH | 0.856 | 0.77 to 0.93 |

## Limits
- 86 wrong readings, one recording set (cross-validation within it), simulated damage; the first 50 recordings cannot be used because their digitised signals were not saved.
- The output features use the same peak detector as the target, so part of the signal is by design. A deployed check can compute exactly these features, because none uses the reference.
- Not a verdict: exploratory, added after the main plan.
